details: Not Wheelchair Friendly: The temple is built on a high, star-shaped raised platform typical of Kakatiya architecture. There are no ramps leading up to this platform. [[1](https://tourism.telangana.gov.in/destinations/ramappa#:~:text=The%20temple%20is%20built%20on,platform%2C%20with%20intricate%20carvings%20depicting)]

Physical Stairs Required: Visitors must physically climb a flight of steep stone steps to access the main deck and view the inner sanctum. Dependent wheelchair users cannot access the upper structure smoothly.

Flat Ground Premises: The surrounding outer lawn and archaeological pathways maintained by the ASI are relatively flat and can accommodate manual wheelchairs, but the actual temple structure is not accessible without climbing steps.
